results.title: Healthcare expenditure, AMR and public health | Health Wrap Episode 60
results.content: In Episode 60 of Health Wrap by The Hindu, Ramya Kannan, Health Editor, The Hindu, and Zubeda Hamid, Senior Assistant Editor, The Hindu, discuss healthcare expenditure in India, access to reproductive healthcare, and the growing challenge of antimicrobial resistance. The episode also covers the biological differences between egg and sperm production, the illegal human egg collection racket in Telangana and the need for regulation of fertility clinics. Other topics include women’s healthcare, phage therapy and antimicrobial resistance, India’s tuberculosis funding, extreme heat and its effects on pregnant women and newborns, and diabetes screening and community-based diabetes management.
